items.title: Navin Fluorine among 3 stocks closing above VWAP
items.description: On October 30, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1.2% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge's technical scan data.When a stock closes above VWAP, it means its closing price is higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: India’s consumers are back, its stocks aren’t: Srinivasan Sivabalan
items.description: Amid the vibrant festive season in India, consumer demand is soaring, prompting businesses to boost sales and raise prices accordingly. However, rising costs are pressuring profit margins, causing a decline in investor confidence. The stock market struggles to reflect the upbeat consumer activity, signaling a potential need for a resolution to the Iran war and governmental intervention to promote stability.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 6 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, six stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 30, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Indian stocks may recover on steady growth and earnings, Axis AMC says
items.description: Indian stocks are expected to recover in the financial year due to strong earnings and economic growth. The Nifty 50 index has decreased significantly after years of gains, partly due to global issues. The fund manager emphasizes that foreign fund outflows do not indicate a decline in India's growth prospects. Certain sectors like AI, energy, and domestic manufacturing are highlighted for potential investment.

items.title: November could favour bulls, but macro headwinds cloud outlook
items.description: In November, investors are optimistic about Indian equities due to ongoing festive celebrations and better-than-expected corporate earnings. While the Sensex and Nifty boasted gains in October, other market indices saw declines. However, potential threats such as rising crude oil prices and global uncertainties remain. A noticeable surge in purchases by foreign portfolio investors signals renewed interest in Indian stocks.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Platforms, M&M, CDSL, ITC, NTPC, IOCL and Hero MotoCorp
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher on Friday, with significant gains recorded in the Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex. Several major companies, including Reliance Industries and Jio Platforms, published positive quarterly earnings results. Reliance Industries saw a 41% increase in net profit, supported by strong performances in various sectors. Other companies like Sun Pharma and Indian Oil Corporation also reported significant changes in their net profits.

items.title: D-Street poised for a positive start as GIFT Nifty trades firmly higher
items.description: Benchmark indices demonstrated remarkable strength, finishing above key thresholds due to robust demand for large-cap equities. However, surging Brent crude oil prices are still triggering concerns relating to the macroeconomic environment among investors. The India VIX index has recorded a slight increase in market anxiety, signaling cautious attitudes from investors.

items.title: FPI buying returns to Dalal Street as global investors rethink AI bets
items.description: Foreign portfolio investors have shifted from aggressive selling to net buying of Indian equities recently. They invested nearly $1.2 billion over the last ten trading sessions, particularly in large-cap stocks. This change in behavior may be attributed to concerns regarding the artificial intelligence trade influencing investor decisions. Globally, markets saw corrections, while Indian indices had a mixed performance in October.

items.title: Nifty’s next move hinges on breakout above 23,200: Analysts
items.description: Nifty has recently surged by nearly 2%, approaching the resistance level at 23,200. Analysts recommend building long positions to capitalize on a potential breakout. Support is set between 22,600 and 22,800, serving as a buffer. Recommended stocks for investment this week include DLF and Zensar Technologies. Investors should exercise caution in the broader market until significant resistance levels are broken.

items.title: Reliance Retail says profit margins will improve from next year as its online business investments pay off
items.description: With ongoing investments in ecommerce, Reliance Retail expects better Ebitda margins. The company is enhancing dark stores to ensure quicker delivery times and adapting retail spaces to cater to online shoppers. Although recent reports indicate a decrease in net profit, digital commerce still surged by 42%. Jeyandran Venugopal, the chief executive, expresses assurance in maximizing current assets for growth while steering clear of extravagant competitor expenditures.

items.title: Irdai to weigh 650+ responses on insurance commissions
items.description: The regulator had extended the deadline earlier by a week after receiving more than 650 responses to its September 23 consultation paper, which proposes tighter commission limits, changes to expense-of-management rules and a new distribution architecture. The industry is now awaiting the draft guidelines followed by the final framework.

items.title: Banks seek microloan guarantee extension
items.description: IDFC First Bank and small finance banks such as AU, Jana and Suryoday were among the biggest users of the scheme to reduce credit risk. They have set aside the guarantee fee for the current fiscal year, expecting the government to reopen the window soon, people aware of the matter said.

items.title: Banks report 10-50% gains in productivity, turnaround time and costs from AI-led initiatives
items.description: Several banks in India have implemented artificial intelligence initiatives that have increased productivity and efficiency significantly. Notably, Kotak Mahindra Bank has improved its handling of corporate servicing volumes by 20-30% with the same workforce. Axis Bank's AI solutions are enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency across its operations. HDFC Bank has reported a reduction in service delivery turnaround times by 30%, reflecting the impact of digitization.

items.title: Cyberattacks on banks, including AU Small Finance Bank, worry insurers as claim risks rise
items.description: Cyberattacks targeting financial institutions have raised concerns about security vulnerabilities and potential losses. AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a possible data breach involving customer information stored on Salesforce. Insurers have recently reported an increase in cyber incidents affecting banks and manufacturers over the past few months. The extent of these breaches and the impacted customer count are still under investigation.

items.title: Sebi to delist penny stocks: Market regulator plans AI-based surveillance of such firms
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India plans to delist companies that have no economic activity. This move aims to protect investors, especially those investing in penny stocks. The regulator highlights the potential dangers posed by such inactive companies in the market. Additionally, Sebi intends to announce compliance requirements for foreign institutional investors soon.

items.title: 4 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 31% in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: Although the indices are in the green on Monday, the market is extremely volatile. The upmove is being attributed to some recovery in oil prices as a reaction to talk of renewed negotiations to end the US-Iran conflict. But don’t be lulled into complacence by the recent uptick in the indices. The results of the US mid-term elections is the event the market will be watching closely. And which way they go will impact how the global markets behave in the coming weeks.

items.title: Indian IPO market clocks record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, fundraising jumps 30%
items.description: India's mainboard IPO market raised a record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, up 30% year-on-year, as September saw unprecedented fundraising. Strong investor participation, confidential filings and a robust pipeline supported primary market momentum.

items.title: FIIs increase stake: 11 Nifty stocks rally up to 50% in FY27 so far
items.description: Tracking foreign institutional investor (FII) activity can offer insights into market trends, as these investors typically make stock selections based on detailed research and conviction. An analysis of the Nifty 50 universe shows that FIIs increased their stake in 19 companies in the September 2026 quarter compared with the June 2026 quarter. Interestingly, 11 of these stocks have delivered gains ranging from 10% to 50% in FY27 so far, highlighting how several stocks attracting increased foreign investor interest have also witnessed strong price momentum. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: MobiKwik shares zoom 10% as fintech firm posts record Rs 12 crore profit in Q2
items.description: MobiKwik returned to profitability in Q2 FY27, reporting a record consolidated net profit of Rs 11.8 crore against a loss of Rs 28.6 crore a year earlier. Profit rose over 55% sequentially from Rs 7.6 crore in Q1 FY27, while revenue from operations increased 9% year-on-year to Rs 1,082.6 crore.

items.title: Missed Reliance Industries’ historic 8% one-day rally? Here’s what technical analysts are saying
items.description: Reliance Industries shares surged on Monday, marking their sharpest single-day rally in nearly seven years and adding Rs 1 lakh crore to its market capitalisation, taking it to Rs 17 lakh crore. The rally followed strong Q2 FY27 results, with consolidated net profit rising 41% year-on-year to Rs 25,548 crore and revenue growing 29% to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. The oil-to-chemicals segment led earnings growth, with EBITDA jumping 68% to a record Rs 25,203 crore.

items.title: Coal India shares jump 4% after firm records highest-ever monthly coal supplies in October
items.description: Coal India shares jumped more than 4% after the state-run miner reported record monthly coal production and supplies in October. Total supplies crossed 70 million tonnes for the first time, while deliveries to the power sector reached an all-time high of 57.1 million tonnes.

items.title: Dixon Technologies shares gain 11% after Q2 revenue jumps 47% YoY
items.description: Dixon Technologies shares surged 11% after the company reported a 46.7% YoY rise in Q2FY27 revenue to Rs 21,794 crore. However, net profit fell 48.7% to Rs 343.7 crore, while EBITDA declined 37% to Rs 666 crore. EBITDA margin contracted to 3.1% from 7.1% a year ago, despite higher revenue and operating profit growth.

items.title: Sebi backs removal of LTCG tax for foreign investors: Report
items.description: To boost foreign investment interest, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth a proposal to scrap long-term capital gains tax for foreign investors and extend tax relief to mutual fund investors. This move is designed to counteract the high capital gains taxes and transaction costs faced by foreign entities, aiming to enhance the overall attractiveness of India's equity market.

items.title: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jump 14% in 2 days, m-cap swells by Rs 1,600 crore after Q2 results
items.description: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jumped 6% on Monday after rallying 8.5% in the previous session, adding nearly Rs 1,600 crore to its market capitalisation. The gains followed a strong Q2 performance, with the company reporting a net profit of Rs 746 crore against a loss of Rs 91 crore a year ago, despite a sequential decline.

items.title: GAIL shares jump 4% as Q2 net profit rises over 8% to Rs 4,650 crore, revenue grows 17%
items.description: GAIL shares rose nearly 4% after the company reported strong second-quarter profit and revenue growth, supported by its gas marketing and transmission businesses. Investor sentiment was also buoyed by the board’s in-principle approval to list subsidiary GAIL Gas through an IPO.

items.title: PC Jeweller shares drop 4% after Sebi sends warning letters to MD, company secretary. Here's why
items.description: PC Jeweller shares fell over 4% after Sebi issued warning letters to two senior executives for failing to maintain a structured digital database linked to a 2025 business update. The company said the warnings would have no financial or operational impact.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares set for biggest-single day jump since April 2020 as Q2 earnings spark Rs 1 lakh crore rally
items.description: Reliance Industries shares surged nearly 7.5% after reporting outstanding Q2 results for FY27. The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. Many international brokers are holding onto 'Buy' ratings, anticipating considerable upside for the stock. These recent gains have helped Reliance rebound from a 52-week low recorded earlier this month.

items.title: US midterm elections begin tomorrow: Can Trump’s likely defeat sparkle Sensex, Nifty? Here’s what analysts say
items.description: The November 3 US midterm elections could reshape control of Congress, with analysts anticipating potential Republican losses. A divided government may heighten market volatility, although historical annualised returns remain largely unaffected. For Indian investors, the key concerns are the dollar, US bond yields, crude oil prices and foreign fund flows amid an already challenging market environment.

items.title: Cheap stocks aren’t enough: The one trigger FIIs need to return to India
items.description: FIIs have pulled nearly $64 billion from Indian equities over the past two years, marking the longest and deepest sell-off in two decades, according to JM Financial. Despite cheaper valuations and an improving earnings outlook, foreign investors remain on the sidelines, with a sustained decline in crude oil prices emerging as a key trigger for their return.

items.title: Wall Street rushes in with bullish calls on India’s top bourse
items.description: Wall Street brokerages are turning bullish on NSE, citing its dominant market position and India’s expanding capital markets. Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and 360 ONE recommend buying the stock, projecting up to 30% upside. Rising investor participation, trading activity and new businesses could drive long-term revenue and earnings growth.

items.title: Diwali stocks to buy! 8 stocks with upside potential of up to 52%
items.description: Samvat 2082 proved challenging for Indian equities, marked by heightened volatility, intermittent recoveries and a significant correction in benchmark indices. Over the next 12 months, the sustainability and breadth of corporate earnings growth are likely to be the key drivers of equity market returns. Here are 9 stocks Axis Direct is bullish on this Diwali.ITC Ltd. has a target price of Rs 360 against its current market price (CMP) of Rs 259, indicating an upside potential of 39%. The stock carries a BUY recommendation.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Tata Steel among 5 stocks to buy on Tuesday for healthy returns
items.description: Indian equities experienced a strong start to the week, bolstered by better than expected Q2 earnings. Improved domestic macro indicators contributed to the positive sentiment among investors and traders. Increased passenger vehicle sales and gross GST collections reflected resilience in domestic economic activity. Several stock recommendations were highlighted for Tuesday, suggesting potential upward movements. Analysts shared technical insights indicating opportunities for buying various stocks in the current market.

items.title: These large-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of over 25%
items.description: Oil prices matter to the Indian economy, and the market responded with a smart rally as Brent crude cooled significantly on Monday. The rally was broad-based and involved all segments. But too much should not be read into one day’s showing. The thing to watch remains the results of the US mid-term elections which will be known in India through Wednesday. It will decide which way the market will move in the coming days and weeks.

items.title: Coforge among 4 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 15% in a month
items.description: On Monday, the Sensex skyrocketed over 1,200 points to close at 75,692. Four stocks from the BSE 100 index touched fresh 52-week highs, marking their highest price levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the preceding 12 months and may indicate increased market activity and investor interest.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A metals major for a 4.85% upmove, a large-cap natural gas supplier’s stock for a gain of 7%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
items.description: Indian stock markets surged nearly 2% on November 2, with Sensex gaining 1,233 points and Nifty rising 388 points. Falling crude oil prices, strong corporate earnings, positive global cues and foreign investor buying boosted sentiment.

items.title: EAAA India draws HDFC MF, Carnelian Asset, and L&T in Rs 316 crore listing-day bulk deals
items.description: EAAA India Alternatives attracted Rs 316.3 crore in listing-day bulk deals from HDFC Mutual Fund, Carnelian Asset Management and L&T. The stock listed at a marginal premium before gaining 3.8% over its IPO price.

items.title: Why traders are moving away from equity F&O to commodities? Nithin Kamath explains
items.description: Commodity derivatives traders in India surged nearly 62% to 21 lakh in FY26, while equity F&O participants fell 20% to 85 lakh. Zerodha's Nithin Kamath cited commodity volatility, options popularity and extended MCX trading hours.

items.title: IPO-bound StockGro's profit jumps 3-fold to Rs 113 cr in FY26 on strong revenue growth
items.description: In FY26, StockGro showcased substantial growth, achieving a profit after tax of Rs 112.96 crore while nearly doubling its revenue to Rs 226.14 crore, largely propelled by rising subscription fees. Operational costs increased, leading to higher total expenses. As the company gears up for an IPO, preliminary papers have been submitted to Sebi, with StockGro currently serving over 35 million users and capitalizing on India’s booming retail investment market.

items.title: Sebi cuts cooling-off period for OFS by privately listed illiquid InvITs to 8 weeks
items.description: Sebi has announced a reduction in the cooling-off period for illiquid private listed InvITs. The previous cooling-off period was set at 12 weeks, which has now been changed to 8 weeks. This decision comes in response to feedback from market participants and aims to enhance the ease of doing business. Illiquid InvITs typically face challenges due to low trading volumes and large lot sizes.

items.title: Fusion Finance swings to Rs 86.5 crore profit as asset quality improves
items.description: Fusion Finance reported a net profit of Rs 86.5 crore in Q2, reversing a year-ago loss of Rs 22.1 crore. Gross NPAs improved to 1.6%, AUM grew 14%, and NIM expanded to 12.5%.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Market wrap:  RIL, Tata Steel, Infosys, ICICI Bank top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
items.description: Indian markets rallied sharply, with Sensex gaining 1.66% to 75,693 and Nifty rising 1.68% to 23,441. Strong quarterly earnings lifted investor sentiment, led by Reliance Industries, metals and oil and gas stocks, while market breadth remained positive.

items.title: Diwali cheer! Mukesh Ambani gets $8.5 billion richer in a day as RIL shares soar
items.description: Mukesh Ambani experienced a significant increase in wealth following a rally in Reliance Industries shares. The company's stock rose by 11.64%, marking its strongest gain in over six years. Reliance's quarterly earnings surpassed expectations, especially in its oil-to-chemicals and telecom sectors. Analysts have since shown increased optimism about the company's financial outlook and growth prospects. However, challenges remain for Reliance's retail business and overall stock recovery.

items.title: Ashish Kacholia-owned Knowledge Marine shares jump 4% on Rs 303 crore order win; stock up 67% in 2026
items.description: Knowledge Marine shares gained 4.17% after securing a Rs 303.17 crore, three-year maintenance dredging contract from New Mangalore Port Authority. The company also announced a November 6 record date for its five-for-one stock split.

items.title: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surge 17% as Q2 FY 27 profit jumps 35% YoY to Rs 21 crore
items.description: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surged nearly 17% after the company reported a 35.5% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit and 30.5% revenue growth. Strong pharma and FMCG packaging volumes supported performance, while new product launches and expansion plans strengthened its growth outlook.
